title: Final readiness, polish, and the repeat loop
objective: Final 100-problem review sprint, portfolio case studies final, final readiness checklist, and the maintenance rhythm for months 13+. Make the profile resilient even if Google timing does not align.
topics: Portfolio final pass: 3 flagships + capstone only
theory: Google M12; Blueprint Sheet 04 maintenance; reference CI-5 staying current.
deliverables: Final Checklist section fully ticked (or honest gaps listed)
review/top100.md all re-solved cold at least once
docs/maintenance.md (DSA 3–4 h/week, projects alive, Quiet Network, quarterly self-audit)
checkpoint: Every flagship demo still works from a fresh browser
You can state next quarter’s plan in 3 sentences

knowledge: Which top100 problems still exceed 35 minutes?
What is next quarter’s plan in 3 sentences?
practical: Final Checklist ticked or gaps dated

tasks.text: Cold re-solve 12 problems from top100 (timed, narrating); log times; anything >35 min goes to a “drill again in 7 days” list.
Fresh-browser check: PairCraft, AtlasAI, Paper-to-Prod, capstone — every demo, every link in every README works. Fix breakage.
10-min recall: explain yesterday’s “Fresh-browser check: PairCraft, AtlasAI, Paper-to-Prod, capstone — every demo, every link ” aloud without notes; write one gap you found.
Final Checklist (✅ section): go category by category; tick only what is true; list honest gaps with a date to close each.

Portfolio pass: keep the 3 flagships + capstone pinned; everything else unpinned unless genuinely strong; READMEs consistent (problem → architecture → numbers → limitations); case studies linked; demo videos current.

docs/maintenance.md for months 13+: DSA 3–4 h/week (top100 rotation + 1 timed set), keep flagships alive (monthly dependency/eval run), Quiet Network 2 conversations/week, 2 newsletters max, one paper/month, quarterly 15-min self-audit, annual switch review.
Horizon decision: read the Horizon section; choose the months 13–18 lane (specialization fork, first cert, Germany prep yes/no); write 3 sentences.
One last full loop simulation: 2 coding (45 min each) + 1 SD + 1 behavioral, back to back with breaks; debrief each within the hour.
Write the year review: what the diagnostic looked like in W1 vs now; the three things that moved the needle; what you would cut. Post it.
Applications + follow-ups; tracker; set the weekly maintenance calendar blocks for months 13+.

Weekly revision — top100 cold re-solves (finish), Final readiness checklist (all 9 categories), Portfolio final pass: 3 flagships + capstone only, Maintenance rhythm for months 13+: rewrite the key ideas from memory (no notes), then compare with your notes and fix the gaps. Reimplement two things from this week without looking.
DSA second pass · cold re-solve: Unique Paths (Medium, B75) · Longest Common Subsequence (Medium, B75) — ≤35 min each, narrate, log time.
Weekly review: answer this week’s knowledge questions aloud, run the practical checks, then write the three notes (struggled / learned / improve) in Weekly Plan → Review. Update the tracking sheet.

JS/MERN spaced recall (Cycle 3 · interview mode) · Browser platform & full-stack auth flow: Interview mode: explain the rendering pipeline + Core Web Vitals and design secure auth for a MERN app in 5 min. Log misses in mistakes.md; if you fail the check, redo the matching module in Side Tracks → 🟨 JavaScript & MERN Refresher.
